t1.title: money.split 修复
t1.prompt: Fix ledgerkit/money.py split(total_cents, weights). It must return integers that sum exactly to total_cents, proportional to weights, using the largest remainder method: give each party the floor of its exact share, then hand the leftover cents one at a time to the parties with the largest fractional remainder, breaking ties by the lower index. A negative total splits like its absolute value with every result negated. Raise ValueError if weights is empty, any weight is negative, or all weights are zero. Use exact integer arithmetic, not floats. Add tests in tests/test_money.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.

t2.title: durations 解析
t2.prompt: Create ledgerkit/durations.py with parse(text) and format(seconds). parse accepts units d, h, m, s written largest to smallest, each at most once, with optional spaces between parts, such as '1h30m', '2d 3h', '90s', and decimals such as '1.5h'. A leading '-' negates the whole value. It returns seconds as an int when the value is whole, otherwise a float. Raise ValueError for empty text, a bare number like '5', a unit with no number, repeated units, or units out of order. format(seconds) takes a whole number of seconds and returns the canonical form using d, h, m, s, omitting zero parts, '0s' for zero, and a leading '-' for negative values, so format(5400) is '1h30m'. parse(format(x)) must equal x. Add tests in tests/test_durations.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.

t3.title: TTLCache
t3.prompt: Create ledgerkit/cache.py with class TTLCache(maxsize, ttl, clock=time.monotonic). Methods: put(key, value), get(key, default=None), __len__, __contains__, and a stats() method returning a dict with hits, misses and evictions. It is an LRU cache: when full, put evicts the least recently used live entry, counted as an eviction. Entries expire ttl seconds after their last put; get refreshes LRU order but not expiry. An entry is expired once clock() - stored_time >= ttl. Expired entries are never returned, do not count in len, and must be dropped before any LRU eviction so that a live entry is not evicted while an expired one exists; dropping an expired entry is not an eviction. put on an existing key replaces the value, restarts its ttl and refreshes order. get on a missing or expired key counts a miss. __contains__ does not change order or stats. Raise ValueError if maxsize < 1 or ttl <= 0. All methods must be safe under concurrent threads. Add tests in tests/test_cache.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.

t4.title: free_slots 时区
t4.prompt: Create ledgerkit/slots.py with free_slots(busy, day_start, day_end, min_minutes=0). busy is a list of (start, end) timezone-aware datetimes, possibly overlapping, unsorted, and in different UTC offsets. day_start and day_end are timezone-aware datetimes. Return the free gaps inside [day_start, day_end] as a sorted list of (start, end) tuples, expressed in the timezone of day_start. Busy intervals are clipped to the window; ones entirely outside are ignored; touching busy intervals merge, so no zero-length gap is returned. Only keep gaps at least min_minutes long. Raise ValueError if any datetime is naive, if any interval has end < start, or if day_end <= day_start. Zero-length busy intervals are ignored. Add tests in tests/test_slots.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.

t5.title: TokenBucket
t5.prompt: Create ledgerkit/limiter.py with class TokenBucket(rate, capacity, clock=time.monotonic). rate is tokens per second, capacity the maximum. It starts full. try_acquire(n=1) returns True and takes n tokens if available, otherwise False and takes nothing. wait_time(n=1) returns seconds until n tokens would be available, 0 if available now, and takes nothing. Raise ValueError if rate <= 0, capacity <= 0, n <= 0, or n > capacity, for both methods. Refill is lazy and capped at capacity. If the clock goes backwards, no tokens are added or removed and the bucket continues from the new time without losing later refill. Accumulated floating point error must not be able to deny a request that is exactly affordable: after waiting exactly wait_time(n) seconds from an empty bucket, try_acquire(n) must succeed, even over thousands of cycles with rates such as 0.1, 3 or 7. All methods must be safe under concurrent threads, so N threads can never acquire more than the tokens that exist. Add tests in tests/test_limiter.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.

t6.title: CsvStream 流式解析
t6.prompt: Create ledgerkit/csvstream.py with class CsvStream(delimiter=','). feed(chunk) takes a str of any length and returns the list of rows completed by it, each row a list of str. finish() returns any final row and resets for reuse. Parse RFC 4180: fields may be quoted with double quotes, a doubled quote inside is one quote, quoted fields may contain delimiters and newlines. Record ends are LF, CRLF or lone CR, and a CRLF split across two chunks is one record end, never two. Results must be identical however the input is split, including one character at a time and a quote pair split across chunks. A blank line produces no row. A trailing record with no final newline is returned by finish(); a final empty line produces no row, but input ending in a delimiter such as 'a,' gives ['a', '']. A quote inside an unquoted field is an ordinary character. Characters after a closing quote other than a delimiter or record end raise ValueError from feed or finish. finish() raises ValueError if a quoted field is still open. A quoted empty field on its own line, '""', gives ['']. Do not use the csv module. Add tests in tests/test_csvstream.py and run python3 -m pytest -q.
